name: Gurmar Powder 100gm – Helps Sugar Control
original_description:
Gurmar Powder – Helps Sugar Control and It can help to maintain good health of the kidney.

Gurmar means “sugar destroyer” in Sanskrit. Gurmar (Gymnema) has been shown in human and animal research to assist maintain blood sugar levels. It is said to contain astringent and hepatic stimulating effects that may operate on the pancreas, adrenal glands, and digestive glands to keep blood sugar levels balanced.

Benefits of  Gurmar Powder:

  • It can help maintain the metabolic activities of the liver, kidney and spleen
  • It also can help to reduce pain in calves and weakness
  • It can also help to get relief from numbing and crawling sensations
  • It can help to maintain good health of the kidney
Dosage:

Take 2 – 3 gm powder twice a day, or as directed by the physician.
rewritten_description:
Gurmar Powder is a traditional Ayurvedic herb known as "sugar destroyer" in Sanskrit. This powder has been used for centuries in Ayurvedic practices to support overall well-being. The unique properties of Gurmar are believed to have a positive effect on the body's natural processes.

Gurmar Powder is thought to support the body's natural ability to maintain balance and promote healthy metabolic functions. It is also believed to have a positive impact on the liver, kidney, and spleen, helping to maintain their natural functions. Additionally, it may help reduce discomfort in the calves and alleviate numbness and tingling sensations.

To use Gurmar Powder, take 2-3 grams twice a day, or as directed by a healthcare professional.
